note: Every full-size training arm of the study of 19 to 20 November 2026, in the order it was started. A stack arm is the stack command below with the arm's flags added, where a flag given again replaces the value of that command, and a Transformer arm is the Transformer command with its flags. All arms share the last command line. stop_at is the update at which an arm was told to stop; the learning rate follows a cosine over the 90,000 updates of the schedule whatever stop_at says. An arm with continues took over the saved state of another arm at that update, and its curve starts there. diagnosis_build names the switches of experiments/stack/diagnosis_build.py that an arm ran with: SNN_REAL, SNN_LN, SNN_LN_OUT, SNN_NORM and SNN_NOCEIL are float stand-ins and no spike mechanisms. Curves hold the validation loss of the last weights (val_bpb) and of the running weight average (averaged_val_bpb) on 16 batches of 8 windows from an empty state, and for the later stacks the same weights on unbroken validation streams (stream_val_bpb, averaged_stream_val_bpb), where every scored byte has at least 1,024 bytes behind it. The two kinds of validation read other bytes and are not comparable with each other, and the stream numbers of an arm with other windows or pieces are not comparable with those of the rest. Four arms that were started again before their first evaluation are listed once.
